title: Protocol to Investigate Tumor 3D Co-Culture Secretome
author: ANNA MARIA AP FERNANDES
materials: Thaw HT-29 and 3T3-L1 cells and propagate in culture using Modified Dulbecco Eagle Medium (DMEM - Sigma D-5648, São Paulo, Brazil), supplement with 100 millimolar (mM) sodium pyruvate (Gibco -11- 360, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, Massachusetts, USA), 10 % (v/v) fetal bovine serum (Gibco 2010-09, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, Massachusetts, USA) and 1 % (v/v) antibiotics ( 100 U/ml of penicillin and 10 mg/mL of streptomycin (Gibco 15140-122, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, Massachusetts, USA).
Determine cell viability in a Neubauer chamber using Trypan Blue (Gibco 15250061, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, Massachusetts, USA)

Complete with 250 µL of supplemented medium Modified Dulbecco Eagle Medium (DMEM - Sigma D-5648, São Paulo, Brazil), supplement with 100 millimolar (mM) sodium pyruvate (Gibco -11- 360, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, Massachusetts, USA), 10 % (v/v) fetal bovine serum (Gibco 2010-09, Fisher Scientific, Waltham, Massachusetts, USA) and 1 % (v/v) antibiotics ( 100 U/ml of penicillin and 10 mg/mL of streptomycin) (Gibco 15140-122, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, Massachusetts, USA) to a volume of 250 µL, /well
Keep the magnetic coupling drive for 7 days.

The statistical analyses were performed using the Metaboanalyst web platform (version 5.0 - https://www.metaboanalyst.ca/). For the negative ionization mode: data was normalized by the IS ( p-Fluoro-DL-phenylalanine Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog # F525 ), log-transformed, and Pareto scaled. The same procedure was used for the positive ionization mode, but the cubic transformation was applied instead of the log. Perform multiple volcano plots to test between the compared culture conditions and also to blank samples.

steps.title: Maintain Cell Cultures
steps.instruction: Culture human colon carcinoma (HT-29) and pre-adipocytes (3T3-L1) cells in a humidified chamber at 37 °C with 5% (v/v) CO2.

steps.title: Disaggregate and Propagate Cells
steps.instruction: Incubate cell cultures with 3 mL of 0.25% (v/v) trypsin-EDTA at 37 °C for three minutes. Inactivate trypsin using DMEM plus 10% FBS, then transfer the cell pellet to a new 75 cm3 flask (T75) containing 10 mL DMEM.

substeps.instruction: Change culture medium according to cell doubling time.

steps.title: Prepare Magnetic Nanoparticles
steps.instruction: Remove magnetic nanoparticles from the refrigerator and thaw at room temperature (20-25 °C) for approximately 15 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare HT-29 Cells for Levitation
steps.instruction: Culture HT-29 cells (passage 12th) in monolayer in a T75 flask until confluence reaches 80%-90%, ensuring cell viability is >75% via Neubauer chamber.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL of magnetic nanoparticles (Nanoshuttle™- PL) per 10,000 cells into the single cell suspension flask.
Homogenize the suspension gently.
Centrifuge at 1500 rpm for 5 minutes, 3 times.

steps.title: Form HT-29 3D Spheroids
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells and fill each well of a cell-repellent 24-well plate to reach 7.5 x 10^3 cells after centrifugation using the Bio-Assembler™ system in n3D Biosciences 24-well configuration.

substeps.instruction: Place a magnetic coupling driver under the plate for 05:00:00 and incubate in a humidified chamber (37 °C, 5% CO2).
Close the plate and place the levitation drive atop the intermediate lid; gently shake the plate back and forth if cells do not immediately levitate.
Verify the cohesion of the formed structures using field microscopy.

steps.title: Prepare 3T3-L1 Adipocytes
steps.instruction: Culture 3T3-L1 cells (600 µL) in monolayer until 90% confluence and >75% viability.

substeps.instruction: Incubate in supplemented medium in a repellent hanging drop plate at 37 °C, 5% CO2, and 95% humidity.
Monitor until aggregates form and differentiate into adipocytes.

steps.title: Establish 3D Co-Culture
steps.instruction: Add 3T3-L1 spheroid suspension into each well of the cell-repellent HT-29 plate using a magnetic pen, 21 days after the start of HT-29 spheroid formation.

substeps.instruction: Maintain the co-culture for 7 days.
Collect culture medium for exchange by using the holding drive to hold the 3D culture down during aspiration.

steps.title: Extract Secretome Samples
steps.instruction: Collect 200 µL of culture medium from each well into a microtube and add 50 µL of iced isopropanol.

substeps.instruction: Store microtubes at -20 °C overnight; prepare each sample in triplicate.
Prepare a pooled quality control (QC) sample by collecting and pooling 20 µL aliquots from each sample, homogenizing, and splitting into vials.
Prepare three blank samples (N=3) using culture medium without cells following the same protocol.
Organize sample sequence: QC sample, blank samples, randomly organized test samples, with a QC sample every 10 samples and as the final sample.

steps.title: Sample Preparation for Analysis
steps.instruction: Centrifuge samples at 12,880 x g at 4 °C for 10 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Remove a 150 µL aliquot of the medium and dry under nitrogen pressure.
Resuspend dry extracts in 150 µL of a 1:1 v/v solution of 200 µM p-Fluoro-DL-phenylalanine (Merck MilliporeSigma #F525) in Methanol (Merck MilliporeSigma #M3641) and MilliQ water.

steps.title: Perform UPLC-MS Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze samples using a UPLC H-class (Waters) with an ACQUITY CSH C18 column (2.1 × 100 mm x 1.7 μm) and a XEVO-G2XSQTOF instrument with an electrospray ion source.

substeps.instruction: Set mobile phase: Phase A (MilliQ water + 0.1% v/v Formic acid) and Phase B (Acetonitrile).
Set flow rate to 0.4 mL/min and temperature to 30 °C.
Set injection volumes: 5 µL for positive ionization and 2 µL for negative ionization.
Perform analyses in both positive (+) and negative (-) ionization modes.
Acquire spectra from 50-1200 Da using MS E approach (6 V low-energy, 15-30 V ramp high-energy).
Use Leucine encephalin (200 PPM in 1:1 Acetonitrile:MilliQ water) as lockmass, infused at 25 μL/min.
Calibrate instrument using 0.5 mM sodium formate solution.

steps.title: Process and Identify Data
steps.instruction: Process .RAW files using Progenesis QI software 2.4.69.11 using centroid data and a mass resolution of 40,000.

substeps.instruction: Perform peak alignment based on QC samples.
Select adduct species for positive mode: [M+H]+, [M+Na]+, [M+K]+, [M+ACN+Na]+, [M+ACN+H]+, [M+H-H2O]+, [M+H-2H2O]+.
Select adduct species for negative mode: [M-H]-, [M+FA-H]-, [M+Na-2H]-, [M-H2O-H]-, [M+Cl]-.
Identify compounds using Lipid Maps, LipidBlast, and Human Metabolome Database with parameters: precursor mass error ≤ 5 ppm, fragment mass error ≤ 10 ppm, mass precision, and isotopic similarity.

steps.title: Analyze Molecular Features
steps.instruction: Rank relevant molecular features based on false discovered ratio (FDR) and log2 fold change (FC) values.

substeps.instruction: Assign cell secretomes by considering only features with an FDR value of 0 when compared to the blank sample secretome.
